setupOptions.name: Install PostgreSQL on Windows
steps: Run installer, set password for 'postgres' user
Ensure PostgreSQL service is started (Windows Services)
Update DATABASE_URL in .env if you used a different password
Verify: Open pgAdmin or run 'psql --version' in new terminal

setupOptions.name: Use Docker (recommended for development)
steps: Run: docker run --name telecaller-db -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=telecaller_crm -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:15
Verify: docker ps (should show telecaller-db running)
DATABASE_URL in .env is already configured for this setup

setupOptions.name: Connect to existing PostgreSQL server
steps: Get connection details from your DBA or cloud provider
Ensure database 'telecaller_crm' exists (or update name in URL)
Ensure your IP is whitelisted if connecting to remote server
